name: xTool M2
notes: Blue lasers: 445 nm. Infrared: 1064 nm, for metal and some plastics. Max speed 600 mm/s. Thickest cut at 100 % power: basswood plywood 8 / 10 / 15 mm, black acrylic 3 / 8 / 11 mm (10 / 20 / 40 W). The M2 also takes a CMYK inkjet module (printing, not a laser) and has no blade cutter.
source: xTool M2 FAQ, https://support.xtool.com/article/3324 (work area per module, wavelengths, max speed, max cutting thickness), read 2026-11-26. Unverified: which operations each module can do. Cutting with the blue lasers is confirmed by the cutting tables; score/engrave for them, and score/engrave without cut for the infrared laser, are assumptions. xTool Studio ids (device code JS002, module strings laser_blue_10W/20W/40W and laser_red_3W): xTool Studio 1.9.11's own M2 extension files (atomm/exts/JS002), read 2026-11-26.
